The journey

Damascus, Syria

Where the craft began

2008 – 2013 · print, colour, graphic design

A graphic design diploma and years in print production: colour separation, rotogravure and flexo plates. This is where I learned that precision and colour are the backbone of everything visual.

Beirut, Lebanon
✓ Beirut stamp

Storytelling with a purpose

2015 – 2020 · journalism, humanitarian, NGO brand

Newsrooms and NGOs: lead video editor at Daraj Media, brand and communications for URDA, and humanitarian films with Al Jazeera and award-winning directors. I learned to hold difficult human stories with care.

The Hague, Netherlands
✓ The Hague stamp

Brand, at agency pace

2021 – present · SuperRebel, social-first & digital

Visual designer at SUPERREBEL.AGENCY: full campaigns end to end, reusable brand systems and asset libraries, and now part of the digital team, building WordPress sites and AI-powered tools that go beyond design and video.

About

Good design.
Human stories.

I'm a visual designer, director and editor with more than ten years across video, motion and graphic design. I keep brands consistent everywhere they appear, and build the templates and asset libraries that let a whole team stay on brand without me in the room.

I created the idea for and directed Khayarat, a short film that holds an important place in my work. Directing is part of my practice alongside design and editing.

I've edited humanitarian and journalistic films for Al Jazeera, supported Lina Sanjab’s documentary editing in Lebanon, and run brand and communications for an international NGO. I now design social-first campaigns and build digital tools in The Hague. I work happily across cultures, in Arabic, English and improving Dutch.
